record: T18A browser persistence inventory (frozen F2W UI)
method: grep of ui/src for localStorage, sessionStorage, indexedDB, document.cookie, getItem/setItem/removeItem and 'storage' events (test files excluded), then reading each owner module. Lines are 1-based against the 222b1e7 export. Every key literal below is asserted at its cited line by tests/contracts/legacy_ui/test_legacy_ui_contract.py::test_persistence_key_evidence.

conventions.inferred: Claims tagged [INFERRED] are reasoned from several locations, not read at one line.

write: ui/src/app/App.tsx:169 (boot: overwritten from GET /settings via settingsFromApiResponse; the server is the source of truth on every page load)

fields.model: string; cborg aliases normalized (agentSettings.ts:93-105,158-164); empty -> backend default
fields.graphSource: 'splash_links' | 'json' (agentSettings.ts:2); ANY stored value other than 'json', including a missing field, loads as 'splash_links' (agentSettings.ts:190)
fields.jsonGraphPath: string; must be a member of jsonGraphPaths else first path (agentSettings.ts:184-186)
fields.jsonGraphPaths: string[]; deduplicated; empty -> [stored path] unless it is the xray demo graph, else DEFAULT_JSON_GRAPH_PATHS (agentSettings.ts:149-156,180-183)
fields.availableGraphs: GraphMeta[] {path, graphId, label} (agentSettings.ts:6-10,198); no element validation

defaults.note: Defaults apply when the key is absent or JSON.parse fails (agentSettings.ts:176,210-212). Absent key -> graphSource 'json'; present key without 'json' -> 'splash_links'. These two defaults differ.

wire_mapping.to_api: graphSourceToApi: 'json' -> 'json', everything else -> 'splash' (agentSettings.ts:220-222); used in settingsToApiPayload (agentSettings.ts:228-249) for PUT /settings
wire_mapping.chat_requests: chatRequestBody does not send graph_source or json_graph_path(s) (liveAgent.ts:295-311); ui_settings carries graphSource:'splash_links' for trace only

keys.migration_rule: Preserve the key, the field names and the 'splash_links' token. Because App.tsx:169 rewrites the key from GET /settings on every boot, the backend graph_source value ('splash' | 'json') determines what the browser stores; a new backend must keep returning one of those two literals on /settings.

keys.value_schema: string[]; on read non-string and blank items are dropped (agentSettings.ts:72-74)
keys.migration_rule: Best-effort cache; quota errors ignored (agentSettings.ts:88-90). Paths are storage/kg-relative strings; a backend that changes path spelling invalidates the cache harmlessly.

keys.value_format: JSON.stringify(ChatSessionStore) with each session's messages sliced to the last 80

value_schema.ChatSession: {id: string, title: string, createdAt: number(ms), updatedAt: number(ms), messages: ChatMessage[]} (chatSessions.ts:29-35)
value_schema.ChatMessage: {id, role:'user'|'assistant', content, question?, highlightNodeIds?, retrievedNodeIds?, confidence?, status?, graphSourceUsed?, elapsedSeconds?(integer), publications?, pending?, retrievedGraph?, turnId?, progress?, annotation?} (chatSessions.ts:10-27; normalized at 92-126)
value_schema.embedded_server_payloads: pending (PendingAction from ChatResponse.pending), publications, retrievedGraph (GraphPayload, kept only when nodes non-empty, chatSessions.ts:70-80), progress (ChatProgressEvent[] SSE progress payloads, chatSessions.ts:128-134), status (ChatResponse.status), turnId (ChatResponse.turn_id)

limits.title: first user prompt, whitespace-collapsed, 60 chars with ellipsis (chatSessions.ts:54-58)
limits.session_id: crypto.randomUUID() or 'chat-<ms>-<rand8>' fallback (chatSessions.ts:47-52); used as ChatRequest.session_id, which the server validates against ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$ max 64 (api.py:128-133)

defaults.value: one fresh session {title:'New chat', messages:[]} active (chatSessions.ts:60-68,181-191)
defaults.on_parse_error: falls through to the legacy key, then a fresh store (chatSessions.ts:204-221)

keys.migration_rule: Old messages persist server payload fragments (status strings, pending envelopes, progress phases, graph node ids, publications). A new backend must keep those literals and shapes readable, because reloaded sessions re-render them without re-fetching. Session ids are the server's per-session memory keys (POST /session/reset, DELETE /session/{id}).

keys.value_schema: ChatMessage[] normalized with the same rules as v2 messages (chatSessions.ts:211)
keys.migration_rule: One-way migration: read only when v2 is absent or unparsable, wrapped into one new session (chatSessions.ts:208-217), deleted on the next successful v2 save (chatSessions.ts:235). Keep this read path; do not write v1.

value_schema.StoredFavorite: {key: string, savedAt: number(ms), publication: PublicationInfo} (publicationFavorites.ts:7-11); items failing these typeof checks are dropped on read (publicationFavorites.ts:29-36)
value_schema.key: 'doi:<lowercased doi>' else 'source-title:<lower source_paper>:<lower paper_title or source_paper>' (publicationFavorites.ts:14-20)

keys.server_alignment: Same key rule as backend _publication_key (app/modules/f2w_agent/api.py:868-875) except the browser falls back to source_paper when paper_title is empty (publicationFavorites.ts:18) [INFERRED: keys diverge only for publications with no DOI and no title].
keys.sync: cross-tab 'storage' event (publicationFavorites.ts:96-100); same-tab CustomEvent 'fair2wise-favorites-changed' (publicationFavorites.ts:5,47-50) - an event name, not a storage key
keys.migration_rule: Bookmarks hold a full PublicationInfo copy and are never refreshed from the server. Keep DOI/title spelling stable so keys still match publications in new ChatResponse/PublicationSearchResponse payloads.

keys.value_format: raw string (not JSON): a graph node id from a [KG: ...] citation, possibly graph-prefixed or a Tiled identity ref
keys.migration_rule: Tab-scoped. Holds old node ids across reloads, so node ids (and the Tiled 'beamline:'/'tiled:' prefixes resolved at ChatSidebar.tsx:753-755) must keep resolving after any backend revision.

clear: ui/src/app/components/GraphSourceSelect.tsx:51 (the remembered id is no longer listed by GET /v1/graph/sources)

keys.value_format: raw string (not JSON): an opaque server source id, `json:<name>` or `tiled:<graph>`; only a value matching GRAPH_SOURCE_ID_RE is read back or stored
keys.added: 2026-11-06 (owner instruction: the UI reads both JSON KGs and Tiled KGs); not part of the frozen T18A baseline. See docs/migration/reviews/H8/ui_graph_sources.md.
keys.migration_rule: Absent means the default graph (no `source` query parameter is sent). Ids are server-allowlisted and may disappear (file removed, Tiled graph retired): the selector then falls back to the default. Never store a path or URL.
